title: Message
description: A single entry in the canonical_transcript (§2.4). The `type` discriminator selects the `content` shape and the per-type optional annotations. Ordering across a transcript array (`(round, turn_index)`) is a runtime invariant — §4.10 invariant 7 — not enforced by this schema.

id.description: Globally unique message id within the session (e.g. UUIDv4 or a session-scoped sequence). The runtime owns id allocation.

speaker.description: Identifier of the producer (agent id, originator id, or the literal `runtime` for `panel_contraction`).

target.description: Optional addressee field, advisory at the message level. The canonical list of routed addressees is in `content.direct_requests` for primary/branch turns.

content.description: Per-type payload. The shape is fixed by the per-type conditional below. The top-level type union accepts string (for `problem_statement`) or object (for every other type); the per-type allOf branch pins the exact shape.

parent_id.description: Reference to the parent message id for `branch_turn`; null for every other type. Per-type constraints enforce non-null on `branch_turn`.

round.description: Round counter. 0 for `problem_statement`; ≥1 for every other type.

branch_depth.description: 0 at round level; 1 inside a fork. MVP cap enforced in §4.5.

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 datetime of when the runtime appended the message. Persisted for audit; not used by the scheduler for ordering.

usage.description: Token and cost accounting attributable to this message. Zero for runtime annotations (`panel_contraction`) and the `problem_statement`.

suggested_followups.description: Branch-turn annotation: branch-agent direct_requests recorded as suggestions, not routed (§4.5).

dropped_deferred.description: Primary-turn annotation: direct_requests whose deferral was rejected by the queue cap (§4.6).

schema_failure.description: Primary-turn or branch-turn annotation: request-level schema failures encountered when parsing the turn's direct_requests (§4.5).

offending_request.description: The raw request object that failed validation (preserved verbatim for audit).

reason.description: Contraction reason; matches a subset of the termination-reason enum used at the agent level.
